raw_tokens.value: Lore Warden ~ Know Thy Enemy ~ AG

When the lore warden succeeds at a Knowledge check to identify a creature's abilities and weaknesses, she can also use a standard action to grant herself a +%1 insight bonus on all attack and weapon damage rolls made against that enemy. This bonus lasts for %2 rounds, or until the lore warden uses this ability against a different creature.|LoreWardenKnowThyEnemy|max(2,FighterLVL/2)
She also gains a +2 bonus to her AC against the creature when using this ability.|PRECLASS:1,Fighter=11
